build_weighted_mse_loss: build a weighted MSE loss function that computes squared error between input and target tensors using spatial weights
build_weighted_rmse_loss: build a weighted RMSE loss function that computes root mean square error between input and target tensors using spatial weights
build_weighted_mean_loss: build a weighted mean loss function that computes the weighted mean of arbitrary tensors using normalized spatial weights
test_select_tensors: test the select_tensors function to transpose batch and sample dimensions from B,N,C,H,W to N,B,C,H,W
refactor_weighted_mse_loss: refactor the weighted_mse_loss function to support custom reduction strategies beyond per-sample scalar output
